Wrote /home/ubuntu/icsdiff/icsdiff.py (stdlib only, single file) and ran it locally. Parser: unfolds CRLF/LF continuation lines, parses name;params:value with quoted-param handling, tracks BEGIN/END nesting (VALARM inside VEVENT is skipped), unescapes TEXT values. Events keyed by (UID, RECURRENCE-ID) when RECURRENCE-ID present, else UID. Compared fields: start, end, summary, location in that order; end falls back to DTSTART+DURATION when DTEND is absent. Times are kept as naive wall-clock values plus a tz label (TZID / UTC / floating) and printed as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD for VALUE=DATE; no conversion. Header of CHANGED entries uses the OLD start/summary and sections are sorted by start (dates sort before times on the same day, then UID for ties). Exit codes: 0 no diff (no output), 1 differences, 2 on ParseError (missing file, non-UTF-8, malformed line, bad BEGIN/END nesting, invalid date/duration, VEVENT lacking UID or DTSTART) with message on stderr.

Tested with two hand-written .ics files covering: added/removed events, a TZID event with changed start/end/summary, an unchanged RRULE master plus a moved RECURRENCE-ID override (correctly reported as REMOVED old override + ADDED new override, master unchanged), an all-day event with changed DTEND and an escaped comma in SUMMARY, identical files (exit 0, no output), an invalid DTSTART (exit 2), and a missing file (exit 2). Output matched the requested shape.

Decisions/caveats: (1) a missing field prints as (none) in a changed line, since the spec gives no representation; (2) if start/end wall clock is identical but the TZID differs, the field is reported as changed and the tz name is appended to both sides so the line is not a no-op; (3) if the same key appears twice in one file the last occurrence wins; (4) local interpreter was Python 3.10, not 3.11, but nothing version-specific is used. No unit tests were written beyond the manual runs above.
